title: Event-heavy Operations
summary: Design a PostgreSQL 16 operational analytics store for device events, support dashboards, time-range queries, retention, and a disciplined TimescaleDB-not-yet decision.
critical_queries: Anomaly backtrace for a single device over seven days.
Top-N devices by recent anomaly count.
Device timeline with status, firmware, and event context.
Support dashboard by severity and event type.
Partition-pruning check for recent time windows.

security_posture.tenant_isolation: device-fleet scoping through account_id and support-role access rules

operational_notes: The design must start with core declarative partitioning, BRIN on event_time, per-partition device_id btrees, explicit retention, and observable query triage before considering TimescaleDB.
